sentences.ko: 아니, 해 준다고는 했는데, 돈으로는 안 주고 그 가게 적립금으로만 주겠대.
sentences.text: Well, they said they would, but they would only give me store credit.

alts.text: They were gonna, but it's store credit only.
They told me they would; however, they would only offer me store credit.

sentences.note: **store credit**은 반품할 때 돈 대신 받는, 그 가게에서만 쓸 수 있는 금액이에요. **they said they would**처럼 앞에서 말한 동사(환불해 준다)는 빼고 would만 남겨 말해요.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아, 방금 생각났는데 우리 먹을 거 있긴 있어.
sentences.text: Oh, I just remembered we do have something to eat.

alts.text: Wait, we've got food!
I have just remembered that we do, in fact, have something to eat.

sentences.note: **we do have**처럼 동사 앞에 do를 넣으면 "없는 줄 알았는데 있긴 있다"는 강조가 돼요. 상대가 없다고 생각할 때 바로잡는 자리에서 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 해외 안 나가고 늘 이 나라에 있을 사람으로 골라.
sentences.text: Pick somebody who's going to be in the country like all the time.

alts.text: Go with someone who's always around.
Please choose someone who will be in the country at all times.

sentences.note: **be in the country**는 해외에 나가 있지 않고 국내에 있다는 뜻이에요. 끝의 **like all the time**은 "진짜 항상"처럼 말에서 강조할 때 붙여요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 불 좀 살짝 어둡게 할까 봐.
sentences.text: Maybe I'll just turn down the lights a little.

alts.text: Lemme dim the lights a bit.
Perhaps I will lower the lights slightly.

sentences.note: **turn down the lights**는 불을 끄는 게 아니라 조명을 낮추는 거예요. 소리를 줄일 때도 turn down을 써요. **Maybe I'll just**는 "그냥 슬쩍 ~할게" 하고 부드럽게 말을 꺼낼 때 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 드디어 이걸 같이 하게 돼서 진짜 좋다.
sentences.text: And I'm so glad we're finally doing this.

alts.text: Finally! So happy we're doing this.
I am very pleased that we are finally doing this.

sentences.note: **I'm so glad we're finally ...**는 계속 미루던 약속이나 계획을 드디어 할 때 쓰는 말이에요. 오랜만에 만난 친구와 밥 먹을 때 그대로 쓰면 돼요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 위층 올라가서 좀 살살 걸어 달라고 부탁해 보는 게 어때?
sentences.text: Well, why don't you go up there and ask him to just like step lightly, please?

alts.text: Just go upstairs and tell him to walk softer, okay?
Perhaps you could go upstairs and politely ask him to walk more quietly.

sentences.note: **why don't you** 는 '~해 보는 게 어때?' 하고 가볍게 권할 때 씁니다. **step lightly** 는 위층 발소리가 시끄러울 때 '살살 걸어 달라'는 뜻으로 딱 맞는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 우리가 할머니 레시피 알아내려고 애쓰는 거 알면, 할머니가 진짜 좋아하실 거야.
sentences.text: That would actually make my grandma really happy to know that we're trying to figure out her recipe.

alts.text: Grandma would love knowing we're trying to crack her recipe.
My grandmother would be truly delighted to learn that we are trying to work out her recipe.

sentences.note: **figure out** 은 이리저리 해 보면서 '알아내다'라는 뜻으로 일상에서 아주 자주 씁니다. **That would make ~ happy** 는 '그러면 ~가 좋아하겠다'고 상상해서 말할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 오늘을 너한테 최대한 특별한 날로 만들어 주고 싶어.
sentences.text: Now, I want to make this day as special for you as I can.

alts.text: I wanna make today super special for you.
It is my wish to make this day as special as possible for you.

sentences.note: **as special for you as I can** 처럼 **as ~ as I can** 을 쓰면 '내가 할 수 있는 만큼 최대한'이라는 뜻이 됩니다. 생일이나 기념일에 상대에게 마음을 전할 때 잘 어울립니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그냥 바에 갔다가, 한동안 여기저기 좀 걸어 다녔어.
sentences.text: I uh went to a bar and then I just uh just walked around for a while.

alts.text: Hit a bar, then just wandered around a bit.
First I visited a bar, and then I simply walked around for some time.

sentences.note: **walked around for a while** 는 목적지 없이 '한동안 이리저리 돌아다녔다'는 말입니다. 누가 '어디 갔었어?' 하고 물을 때 딱히 한 일 없이 시간을 보냈다고 답하는 자리에서 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그리스에서 그렇게 재밌게 놀다 왔다니 정말 잘됐다.
sentences.text: It's so good that you had such a good time in Greece.

alts.text: So glad Greece was a blast for you.
I am very pleased to hear that you enjoyed your time in Greece so much.

sentences.note: **had such a good time** 은 여행이나 모임이 '정말 즐거웠다'고 할 때 쓰는 기본 표현입니다. 앞에 **It's so good that** 을 붙이면 상대의 좋은 소식에 같이 기뻐해 주는 말이 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends
